summary: The construction of a much-needed addition to St. Paschal Baylon Catholic School is substantially complete. Due to complications with the water supply, I am concerned that the school will not be available for students to occupy in September 2018. We need to ensure that Toronto Water and the Toronto Catholic District School Board are working quickly to find a solution which will allow students to safely occupy classrooms by the start of this school year.
decided: City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, received Item NY32.84 for information.

motions.desc: Majority required - NY32.84 - Filion - Receive the item
